item.title: Ohio midwinter bald eagle survey counts 715 birds across the state
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio — A midwinter bald eagle citizen survey counted 715 bald eagles in Ohio, based on 391 separate reports submitted between Jan. 7 and Jan. 21, according to the Ohio Department of Natural Resources Division of Wildlife.

item.title: Eastern Local School District welcomes new Board of Education member Britney Rucker
item.description: REEDSVILLE, Ohio — At the January Board of Education meeting, Eastern Local School District officially welcomed its newest board member, Britney Rucker, who was sworn in to serve on the Board of Education.

item.title: Southern Local school board approves financial actions, personnel hires at January meeting
item.description: RACINE, Ohio — The Southern Local Board of Education met in regular session for its January meeting at the Kathryn Hart Community Center, conducting a full agenda that included financial approvals, personnel actions and discussion of upcoming district initiatives.

item.title: Mason County candidates begin filing for 2026 West Virginia primary election
item.description: POINT PLEASANT, W.Va. — Voters will head to the polls for the West Virginia primary election on May 12, followed by the general election on Nov. 3.

item.title: 31st Annual Sleighbell Ball to be held Saturday in Point Pleasant
item.description: POINT PLEASANT, W.Va. — The 31st annual Sleighbell Ball will be held Saturday at the West Virginia National Guard Armory in Point Pleasant from 7-11 p.m.

item.title: Wahama FBLA partners with HATS and United Way to deliver student-led service project
item.description: MASON, W.Va. — The Heart of Appalachia Talent Search program recently partnered with United Way of the River Cities and Wahama Jr./Sr. High School’s Future Business Leaders of America to implement a student-driven project that combined leadership development, service learning…

item.title: Drivers in Gallia and Meigs counties among the least distracted, according to new study
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio — A newly released study finds that Ohio drivers are less distracted behind the wheel compared with the nationwide average.

item.title: Area first responders give thanks for support during winter storm
item.description: POINT PLEASANT, W.Va. — In the aftermath of a winter storm that brought snow, frigid temperatures, ice and hazardous road conditions to the River Cities region, officials in Mason County, West Virginia, and Gallia and Meigs counties in Ohio expressed…

item.title: The French Art Colony continues long legacy of cultural enrichment in Gallia County
item.description: GALLIPOLIS, Ohio — The French Art Colony, a regional multi-arts center in Gallipolis, continues its 62-year mission of enhancing the community’s quality of life through the arts, according to Executive Director Cynthia Sexton.

item.title: Mason County BOE hears updates and votes on personnel measures
item.description: POINT PLEASANT, W.Va. — The Mason County Board of Education approved a series of personnel transitions and student opportunities during its latest meeting, including a slate of new teaching hires and the authorization of a high-profile athletic trip.
